description: A front-desk appointment console in Svelte 5 on the Scheduler. A left rail holds the provider roster you toggle to filter the board, a utilization SvGauge and a status legend; the centre has a KPI strip, a slim toolbar and the day scheduler grouped by provider with each doctor's own hours, no double booking and no booking out of hours, a drag-in patient waitlist, a drawer and status-coded cards; and a right panel shows a live patient-flow pipeline of Waiting, Checked in, In room and Completed derived from each appointment's status.

faq.question: How does each provider get their own hours?
faq.answer: Each provider resource carries its business hours and restrictToBusinessHours is on, so the scheduler shades time outside them and rejects drops there; a doctor who starts at ten cannot be booked at nine.

faq.question: How is double booking prevented?
faq.answer: disableConflicts is set, so a drop that would overlap an existing appointment on the same provider snaps back with a message.

faq.question: How is the patient-flow pipeline built?
faq.answer: It is a $derived that buckets the appointment rows by status; changing a status in the drawer or by drag moves the card between stages immediately.
